quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within fifteen feet of an intersection.

activation.condition: Vehicle stopping, standing or parking within fifteen feet of an intersection.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park in the stated intersection proximity unless the stated exception applies.

exceptions.trigger: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception only where the applicable necessity and compliance or direction are established.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original conduct and applicable direction for independent review.
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device

timing.description: Measure original approach, halt onset and dwell relative to the source-bound intersection boundary and governing context.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original actor trajectories and feasible avoidance alternatives are required; necessity remains unjudged.
Identify applicable law and observed conduct independently of a requested halt.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain original governing direction, facing actor and exact halt interval.

parameter_refs.name: front_body_intersection_gap
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: requested body-to-boundary gap in feet; observed gap is measured from original source

parameter_refs.name: halt_cause
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: ordinary destination, observed traffic conflict, police direction or device direction
